title: Investigating Developer-Reported Software Security Testing Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2609.12008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software security testing (SST) is essential for identifying vulnerabilities and improving software security, but developers often face practical challenges when selecting tools, configuring test environments, interpreting scanner outputs, testing authentication workflows, and acting on reported vulnerabilities. This study empirically characterizes developer-reported SST challenges in Stack Overflow (SO) discussions and examines their prevalence, difficulty, temporal evolution, co-occurrence, and taxonomy stability. We analyze 17,743 SO questions collected using SST-related keywords. Through manual labeling, we identify 582 SST-related questions and construct a taxonomy of 8 categories and 31 subcategories. We then analyze these challenges using prevalence, difficulty, correlation, temporal trend, co-occurrence, and held-out stability analyses. translated_title: 研究开发者报告的软件安全测试挑战
translated_abstract: 软件安全测试（SST）对于识别漏洞和提升软件安全性至关重要，但开发者在选择工具、配置测试环境、解读扫描器输出、测试身份验证流程以及处理已报告漏洞时常常面临实际挑战。本研究对Stack Overflow（SO）讨论中开发者报告的软件安全测试挑战进行了实证刻画，并考察了这些挑战的普遍性、难度、时间演变、共现性以及分类体系的稳定性。我们分析了使用软件安全测试相关关键词收集的17,743个Stack Overflow问题，通过人工标注识别出582个与软件安全测试相关的问题，并构建了包含8个大类和31个子类的分类体系。随后，我们通过普遍性分析、难度分析、相关性分析、时间趋势分析、共现分析以及留出稳定性分析对这些挑战进行了研究。结果表明，开发者经常讨论安全发现解读及其可靠性……
tldr: 本研究通过分析Stack Overflow上的17,743个问题，构建了开发者软件安全测试挑战的8大类31子类分类体系，并系统刻画了这些挑战的普遍性、难度、时间演变与共现特征。
en_tdlr: This study empirically characterizes developer-reported software security testing challenges from 17,743 Stack Overflow questions, constructing an 8-category, 31-subcategory taxonomy and analyzing their prevalence, difficulty, temporal evolution, and co-occurrence.
